lines.t: When the shadows fall and the road feels long,
I hear YahuShua saying, “Hold on strong.”
Through trials deep, and mountains high,
His promise shines beyond the sky.
Never give up, YahuShua’s near,
Even through pain, let go of fear.
Truth will rise when hope seems gone,
The dawn will break — keep pressing on.
The fire refines, the storm will fade,
Each step, YahuShua’s hand has made.
The path of faith, though steep and rough,
Is shaped by love that’s strong enough.
Never give up, YahuShua’s near,
Even through pain, let go of fear.
Truth will rise when hope seems gone,
The dawn will break — keep pressing on.
Stand in His promise, trust His design,
Every loss gives way to life divine.
Rise again, your soul will know,
Through every tear, His mercy flows.
Never give up, YahuShua’s near,
Even through pain, let go of fear.
Truth will rise when hope seems gone,
The dawn will break — keep pressing on.
In the quiet heart, His truth is clear,
Never give up — YahuShua’s here.
